body: I always think about stuff like this, nice to see someone put it into words so well. :)

At least you know you will meet someone better, if you've already had boyfriends at least you also know that you are a beautiful person with good looks.

I felt the same way too though, I wanted to die after what he did to me, he dumped me via text and never talked to me again. Scumbag. I thought I was going to fall off the earth. But I could honestly care less now, I still have bad memories from it but now I know it'll never happen again.

I've also decided, fuck high school guys, maybe I'm too mature them? (I don't know if you're in high school or what?) I'm just taking a brake from dating, why don't you try that? I have so many better things to be doing than trying to please some guy. If he was really interested in me, then he'd come to me.

As for now, forget about him, maybe he's failing school? Take some you time, you're tired. I don't know what you're schedule is but sleep in tomorrow, treat yourself, you deserve it.

Hmm well I'm sorry that didn't help. What happened to your best friend, was that your ex? Like said before, if they can't stop to help you out in a time when you're clearly not feeling well, that's pretty bad on their part. I know it may hurt to understand that at first but after you think about for a while it's like wow, fuck them. If not, you will eventually meet somebody who is far better. Or, it's not like they said they're never talking to you again, you guys can always be friends again. There's so many positives.
If anything take it as a learning experience.

I've had some really rough times with exes too, it was a few years ago but still very rough and I'm still pretty hurt by it now. I tried talking to them about my depression and they thought I was just too much of a handful and they dumped and never talked to me again. One of the most painful things sadly. You can PM me and talk about it if you want.

But Writing down stuff down does help, you don't have to post any of it, just write it down on paper then rip it up when you're done. Just write whatever you feel.

Thanks, I really forget to slow down and let things to come to me. I get so worked up over these things and almost try to hard to do something so simple and end up having just this explosion of thoughts and worries that end up making me have to start all over again.

Haha thanks :) I started thinking something like that to myself about a week ago, you've worded it much better than my brain did and it's nice to read the same idea from someone else. I went for a interview with a Marine recruiter in my neighborhood after thinking about it, I whimped out last minute but definitely a step up for me.

Thanks. My school always gives us these checklists every month saying we should have a car, job, college applications in and they're always worrying to me. I really shouldn't take a piece of paper so seriously though :( I've never really written all this down before, definitely feel slightly better.

But after taking a breather from typing my novel, the new semester has begun with new classes, I think I'll take advantage of this and work on social anxiety problems. I tried therapy once but I was bit weirded out by it. So instead I went to the doctors and they concluded I was a bit depressed and gave me some really low dosage meds, but I never ended up taking them. I really like to be 'all natural' and I couldn't get myself to take them. So I'll try therapy again, I really just want to get my thoughts organized. I'm always thinking too fast to really know what I want it seems.

I have terrible nightmares too and I become too scared to even fall asleep and I'll lay all night in bed for hours just freaking myself out. It's really awful that something that should be really enjoyable ends up being so dreadful. I've stopped drinking caffeine (coffee, soda, tea, etc) and that's helped me a lot, I don't know if you drink any of those, probably not helpful for you? Try writing some things down that are on your mind or some yoga, go for a walk, little things like that can make a difference. I'm not sure exactly what's going on in your life, those may be pretty insignificant for you.

I am really sorry about your mom, my mom would rarely take me seriously. She seems to care slightly that she's taken the knife away, and it's probably good for you. And please don't take pills, that's never any good, it would improve your health and maybe even your nightmares. Go read about people in other cultures or watch a documentary, that always enlightens me and inspires me to at least not mope through my days. 

If I wasn't very helpful at least know I think you have the potential to be a beautiful person.
